t: A tiny, cheap RISC-V radio chip with Bluetooth, Zigbee, Thread, and USB.
steps: Buy a Sipeed M0sense from DigiKey or a Sipeed AliExpress store for a few dollars.
Install a RISC-V toolchain and the official bouffalo_sdk from GitHub.
Open the SDK folder in Visual Studio Code.
Build the blink example for the BL702.
Flash it over USB-C with the open blisp tool or the vendor flasher.
Try a GPIO or ADC example next.
Move on to a Zigbee or Thread example from the SDK.
meta: Open Board. From $7.99. A few stores.
